newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Essential Ent in talks to develop land.
newsitem.headline: Essential Ent in talks to develop land.

text.p: Essential Enterprises Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it is in preliminary negotiations with developers to develop a plot of land in Tsuen Wan in Hong Kong's New Territories which may or may not result in an agreement.
The company also said in a statement that an agreement with Guangdong Real Estate (Holdings) Ltd to develop the land ceased to be effective by mutual consent.
"There was not and will not have any capital commitment from the company and legal liability involved," Essential said.
Essential reminded investors to deal with caution in the shares and warrnats of the company.
Essential also said it was not aware of any reasons for the recent rise in its share price and trading volume, it added.
Its shares closed Monday at HK$1.50, up 21 cents or 16 percent from Friday.
"There are no negotiations or agreements relating to intended acquisitions or realisations which are disclosable under the listing rules," the company said.
Essential operates business clubs and engages in general trading and investment.
